description: How the old/new values of a TmChangeDiff row behave when they do not fit the available width. Default Ellipsis keeps the historical single-line truncation; the other values are opt-in (2.12.0, Fáze 7).

members.name: Ellipsis
members.description: Single line, truncated with an ellipsis (the historical behavior, default). Each value keeps its semantic text colour and the strikethrough on the old value.

members.name: Wrap
members.description: The value wraps onto multiple lines instead of truncating — long sentences (a renamed title, a long file name) stay readable. Overflow wraps anywhere, so a run with no spaces still breaks.

members.name: Full
members.description: The value renders in full: no truncation and no wrapping constraint — the row grows with the content. Use for values that must be copied or compared verbatim.
